functions.source:
def get_allowed_equipment_stats(class_key: object, equipment_kind: str, *, item_subtype: str = "") -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return tuple(stat for stat, _weight in get_equipment_stat_weights(class_key, equipment_kind, item_subtype=item_subtype))

def validate_story_quest_definition(quest: StoryQuestDefinition) -> None:
    """Validate one definition without consulting mutable runtime state."""
    _require(_text(quest.quest_id),'quest_id must be non-empty')
    _require(quest.number>0,f'{quest.quest_id}: number must be positive')
    _require(_text(quest.title),f'{quest.quest_id}: title is required')
    _require(isinstance(quest.quest_type,QuestType),f'{quest.quest_id}: invalid quest_type')
    _require(_text(quest.location_id),f'{quest.quest_id}: location_id is required')
    _require(quest.unlock_level>0,f'{quest.quest_id}: unlock_level must be positive')
    _require(_text(quest.giver_npc_id),f'{quest.quest_id}: giver_npc_id is required')
    _require(_text(quest.description),f'{quest.quest_id}: description is required')
    _require(_text(quest.objective_text),f'{quest.quest_id}: objective_text is required')
    _require(quest.target_quantity>0,f'{quest.quest_id}: target_quantity must be positive')
    _require(quest.reward.exp>=0 and quest.reward.gold>=0,f'{quest.quest_id}: rewards cannot be negative')
    if quest.quest_type is QuestType.QUEST_ITEM:
        _require(quest.quest_item is not None,f'{quest.quest_id}: QUEST_ITEM requires quest_item')
        item=quest.quest_item
        _require(_text(item.item_key) and _text(item.display_name),f'{quest.quest_id}: quest item identity is required')
        validate_story_quest_item_key(item.item_key)
        _require(item.required_quantity>0,f'{quest.quest_id}: required_quantity must be positive')
        _require(0<=item.drop_chance<=1,f'{quest.quest_id}: drop_chance must be within 0..1')
        _require(isinstance(item.consume_on_completion,bool),f'{quest.quest_id}: consume_on_completion must be bool')
        _require(quest.target_quantity==item.required_quantity,f'{quest.quest_id}: quantities must match')
    else:
        _require(quest.quest_item is None,f'{quest.quest_id}: quest_item only allowed for QUEST_ITEM')
    if quest.quest_type is QuestType.BOSS:
        _require(_text(quest.boss_key),f'{quest.quest_id}: BOSS requires boss_key')
    else:
        _require(quest.boss_key is None,f'{quest.quest_id}: boss_key only allowed for BOSS')
    if quest.quest_type is QuestType.TURN_IN:
        _require(_text(quest.turn_in_npc_id),f'{quest.quest_id}: TURN_IN requires turn_in_npc_id')
    allowed_consumption = {"default", "none", "atomic_exact_once", "atomic_exact_once_all_or_nothing"}
    _require(quest.quest_item_consumption in allowed_consumption,f'{quest.quest_id}: invalid quest_item_consumption')
    required_keys=set()
    for required in quest.required_quest_items:
        _require(isinstance(required,RequiredQuestItemDefinition),f'{quest.quest_id}: invalid required quest item')
        _require(_text(required.item_key),f'{quest.quest_id}: required item key is required')
        validate_story_quest_item_key(required.item_key)
        _require(required.quantity>0,f'{quest.quest_id}: required item quantity must be positive')
        _require(isinstance(required.consume,bool),f'{quest.quest_id}: required item consume must be bool')
        _require(required.item_key not in required_keys,f'{quest.quest_id}: duplicate required item key')
        required_keys.add(required.item_key)
    if quest.quest_item_consumption == "none":
        _require(all(not item.consume for item in quest.required_quest_items),f'{quest.quest_id}: none policy cannot consume items')
    if quest.quest_item_consumption == "atomic_exact_once_all_or_nothing":
        _require(len(quest.required_quest_items)>1,f'{quest.quest_id}: all-or-nothing requires multiple items')
    if quest.navigation:
        _require(quest.navigation.location_id==quest.location_id,f'{quest.quest_id}: navigation location mismatch')
        _require(quest.navigation.giver_npc_id==quest.giver_npc_id,f'{quest.quest_id}: navigation giver mismatch')
        _require(quest.navigation.turn_in_npc_id==quest.turn_in_npc_id,f'{quest.quest_id}: navigation turn-in mismatch')

functions.source:
def derive_story_quest_status(*,persistent_status,player_level,unlock_level,predecessor_completed,another_active_quest):
    """Return persistent status or derive LOCKED/AVAILABLE without storing it."""
    if persistent_status is not None: return persistent_status
    if player_level<unlock_level or not predecessor_completed or another_active_quest: return DerivedQuestStatus.LOCKED
    return DerivedQuestStatus.AVAILABLE

functions.source:
def init_db():
    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
        user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,

        hp INTEGER,
        max_hp INTEGER,
        level INTEGER,
        exp INTEGER,
        gold REAL,
        kills INTEGER,
        bag_slots INTEGER,
        current_location TEXT DEFAULT 'start_path',

        str INTEGER,
        dex INTEGER,
        intelligence INTEGER,
        wis INTEGER,
        sta INTEGER,

        equipped_weapon INTEGER,
        equipped_armor INTEGER,
        registered_at TEXT DEFAULT ''
    )
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inventory (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        user_id INTEGER,
        item_id INTEGER,
        quantity INTEGER,
        durability INTEGER
    ,
        refine_level INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    )
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT,
        type TEXT,
        rarity TEXT,
        category TEXT,

        slot_key TEXT,
        weapon_hands INTEGER,

        max_stack INTEGER,
        sell_price REAL,

        bonus_str INTEGER,
        bonus_dex INTEGER,
        bonus_int INTEGER,
        bonus_wis INTEGER,
        bonus_sta INTEGER,

        pdef INTEGER,
        mdef INTEGER
    ,
        item_subtype TEXT DEFAULT ''
    ,
        armor_type TEXT DEFAULT ''
    ,
        weapon_min_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    ,
        weapon_max_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    ,
        weapon_min_magic_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    ,
        weapon_max_magic_damage INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    ,
        weapon_attack_type TEXT DEFAULT ''
    ,
        shop_preview_owner INTEGER DEFAULT NULL
    ,
        shop_preview_price INTEGER DEFAULT 0
    )
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS equipment_slots (
        user_id INTEGER,
        slot_key TEXT,
        inventory_id INTEGER,
        PRIMARY KEY (user_id, slot_key)
    )
    """)

    migrations = [
        ("users", "gold", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "kills", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "bag_slots", "INTEGER DEFAULT 60"),
        ("users", "current_location", "TEXT DEFAULT 'start_path'"),

        ("inventory", "quantity", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
        ("inventory", "durability", "INTEGER DEFAULT NULL"),

        ("items", "category", "TEXT DEFAULT 'equipment'"),
        ("items", "slot_key", "TEXT DEFAULT NULL"),
        ("items", "weapon_hands", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
        ("items", "max_stack", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
        ("items", "sell_price", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
        ("items", "bonus_sta", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("items", "pdef", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("items", "mdef", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("items", "item_level", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
        ("items", "is_generated", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),

        ("users", "registered_at", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("users", "daily_contracts_completed", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "daily_contract_date", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),

        ("users", "energy", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "last_energy_update", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("users", "energy_full_notified", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),

        ("users", "last_hp_regen_update", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("users", "hp_full_notified", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
        ("users", "daily_hunts", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "daily_hunts_date", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
    ]

    for table, column, column_type in migrations:
        try:
            cursor.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {column_type}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    cursor.execute("UPDATE users SET gold = 0 WHERE gold IS NULL")
    cursor.execute("UPDATE users SET kills = 0 WHERE kills IS NULL")
    cursor.execute(
        "UPDATE users SET bag_slots = ? WHERE bag_slots IS NULL",
        (DEFAULT_BAG_SLOTS,),
    )  # ROM 17.8.1.1 PARAMETERIZED BAG DEFAULT

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET current_location = 'start_path'
    WHERE current_location IS NULL OR current_location = ''
    """)

    cursor.execute("UPDATE inventory SET quantity = 1 WHERE quantity IS NULL")

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE inventory
    SET durability = 100
    WHERE durability IS NULL
      AND item_id IN (
          SELECT id FROM items WHERE category = 'equipment'
      )
    """)

    conn.commit()

    ]

    # ROM_STAGE_18_29_3A_EVENT_ITEM_CATALOG

def set_player_level_for_test(user_id, target_level):
    try:
        target_level = int(target_level)
    except Exception:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Рівень має бути числом."
        }

    if target_level < 1:
        target_level = 1

    if target_level > 30:
        target_level = 30

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT user_id
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Персонажа не знайдено. Спочатку натисни /start."
        }

    base_stat = 10 + (target_level - 1)

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET
        level=?,
        exp=0,
        str=?,
        dex=?,
        intelligence=?,
        wis=?,
        sta=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        target_level,
        base_stat,
        base_stat,
        base_stat,
        base_stat,
        base_stat,
        user_id
    ))

    conn.commit()

    new_max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET
        max_hp=?,
        hp=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        new_max_hp,
        new_max_hp,
        user_id
    ))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "level": target_level,
        "base_stat": base_stat,
        "max_hp": new_max_hp,
        "message": (
            f"✅ DEV: рівень персонажа встановлено.\n\n"
            f"🏆 Рівень: {target_level}\n"
            f"✨ Досвід: 0/{get_exp_to_next_level(target_level)}\n"
            f"💪 Базові характеристики: {base_stat}\n"
            f"❤️ HP: {new_max_hp}/{new_max_hp}"
        )
    }

def reset_hero_for_test(user_id):
    """Atomically reset character progress without deleting the users parent row.

    Keeping users.user_id in place prevents RESTRICT foreign keys in trade and
    interaction history from breaking the reset. All mutations are enclosed in
    one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction. Every failure performs rollback so the
    shared SQLite connection cannot retain a write lock.
    """
    import time
    from datetime import datetime

    user_id = int(user_id)
    lock = _get_dev_reset_hero_lock()
    last_error = None

    with lock:
        for attempt in range(1, 4):
            stage = "prepare"
            deleted = {}
            try:
                try:
                    conn.rollback()
                except Exception:
                    pass

                conn.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
                conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=30000")
                stage = "begin_immediate"
                conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")

                row = cursor.execute(
                    "SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE user_id=?",
                    (user_id,),
                ).fetchone()
                if not row:
                    conn.rollback()
                    return {
                        "success": False,
                        "message": "❌ Персонажа не знайдено. Спочатку натисни /start.",
                    }

                # Trade children must be removed before player_trades because
                # some installations can have foreign_keys disabled historically.
                stage = "trade_cleanup"
                trade_ids = []
                if _dev_reset_table_exists("player_trades"):
                    trade_ids = [
                        int(row[0])
                        for row in cursor.execute(
                            "SELECT id FROM player_trades WHERE initiator_user_id=? OR recipient_user_id=?",
                            (user_id, user_id),
                        ).fetchall()
                    ]
                if trade_ids:
                    placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in trade_ids)
                    for table_name in (
                        "inventory_reservations",
                        "player_trade_offers",
                        "player_trade_events",
                        "player_trade_history",
                    ):
                        columns = _dev_reset_table_columns(table_name)
                        if "trade_id" in columns:
                            result = cursor.execute(
                                f'DELETE FROM "{table_name}" WHERE trade_id IN ({placeholders})',
                                tuple(trade_ids),
                            )
                            deleted[table_name] = deleted.get(table_name, 0) + max(0, int(result.rowcount or 0))
                    result = cursor.execute(
                        f'DELETE FROM player_trades WHERE id IN ({placeholders})',
                        tuple(trade_ids),
                    )
                    deleted["player_trades"] = max(0, int(result.rowcount or 0))

                stage = "user_child_cleanup"
                user_column_names = (
                    "user_id",
                    "owner_user_id",
                    "initiator_user_id",
                    "recipient_user_id",
                    "actor_user_id",
                    "challenger_user_id",
                    "recipient_id",
                    "initiator_id",
                    "player_one_user_id",
                    "player_two_user_id",
                    "winner_user_id",
                    "loser_user_id",
                )
                protected_tables = {"users", "items", "inventory", "equipment_slots", "inventory_runes", "crystal_wallets", "crystal_transactions"}
                table_names = [
                    str(row[0])
                    for row in cursor.execute(
                        "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'"
                    ).fetchall()
                ]
                for table_name in table_names:
                    if table_name in protected_tables:
                        continue
                    count = _dev_reset_delete_by_user_columns(table_name, user_id, user_column_names)
                    if count:
                        deleted[table_name] = deleted.get(table_name, 0) + count

                stage = "inventory_dependency_cleanup"
                if _dev_reset_table_exists("inventory_runes"):
                    result = cursor.execute(
                        "DELETE FROM inventory_runes WHERE inventory_id IN (SELECT id FROM inventory WHERE user_id=?)",
                        (user_id,),
                    )
                    deleted["inventory_runes"] = max(0, int(result.rowcount or 0))
                if _dev_reset_table_exists("inventory_reservations"):
                    result = cursor.execute(
                        "DELETE FROM inventory_reservations WHERE user_id=? OR inventory_id IN (SELECT id FROM inventory WHERE user_id=?)",
                        (user_id, user_id),
                    )
                    deleted["inventory_reservations"] = deleted.get("inventory_reservations", 0) + max(0, int(result.rowcount or 0))
                if _dev_reset_table_exists("equipment_slots"):
                    result = cursor.execute("DELETE FROM equipment_slots WHERE user_id=?", (user_id,))
                    deleted["equipment_slots"] = max(0, int(result.rowcount or 0))
                if _dev_reset_table_exists("inventory"):
                    result = cursor.execute("DELETE FROM inventory WHERE user_id=?", (user_id,))
                    deleted["inventory"] = max(0, int(result.rowcount or 0))

                stage = "user_in_place_reset"
                now_text = datetime.now().isoformat()
                defaults = {
                    "hp": 170,
                    "max_hp": 170,
                    "level": 1,
                    "exp": 0,
                    "gold": 0.0,
                    "kills": 0,
                    "bag_slots": max(int(globals().get("DEFAULT_BAG_SLOTS", 60)), int(get_bag_capacity(user_id))),  # ROM 17.32.1 preserve account entitlement
                    "current_location": "start_path",  # ROM 18.23.3 DEV reset mirrors new-character start
                    "str": 10,
                    "dex": 10,
                    "intelligence": 10,
                    "wis": 10,
                    "sta": 10,
                    "equipped_weapon": None,
                    "equipped_armor": None,
                    "daily_contracts_completed": 0,
                    "daily_contract_date": "",
                    "daily_hunts": 0,
                    "daily_hunts_date": "",
                    "energy": 0,
                    "last_energy_update": now_text,
                    "energy_full_notified": 1,
                    "last_hp_regen_update": now_text,
                    "hp_full_notified": 1,
                    "character_name": "",
                    "character_class": "",
                    "class_selected_at": "",
                    "class_change_available": 0,
                    "mp": 0,
                    "max_mp": 0,
                    "last_regen_at": now_text,
                    "last_activity_at": None,
                }
                user_columns = _dev_reset_table_columns("users")
                assignments = []
                values = []
                for column, value in defaults.items():
                    if column in user_columns:
                        assignments.append(f'"{column}"=?')
                        values.append(value)
                if not assignments:
                    raise RuntimeError("users table has no resettable columns")
                values.append(user_id)
                cursor.execute(
                    f'UPDATE users SET {", ".join(assignments)} WHERE user_id=?',
                    tuple(values),
                )

                stage = "commit"
                conn.commit()

                # Recreate empty slots only after the atomic reset committed.
                stage = "post_commit_slots"
                ensure_equipment_slots(user_id)

                foreign_key_errors = cursor.execute("PRAGMA foreign_key_check").fetchall()
                if foreign_key_errors:
                    return {
                        "success": False,
                        "message": (
                            "❌ DEV reset completed, але foreign_key_check виявив помилки. "
                            "Не продовжуй тестування до recovery."
                        ),
                        "foreign_key_errors": [tuple(row) for row in foreign_key_errors],
                    }

                return {
                    "success": True,
                    "deleted": deleted,
                    "message": (
                        "✅ DEV: герой повністю скинутий.\n\n"
                        "Створено нового персонажа з нуля:\n"
                        "🏆 Рівень: 1\n"
                        "✨ EXP: 0\n"
                        "🪙 Золото: 0\n"
                        "🎒 Інвентар очищено\n"
                        "🛡️ Спорядження і руни очищено\n"
                        "📜 Контракти та активні взаємодії очищено\n"
                        "📆 Щоденні завдання очищено\n\n"
                        "✍️ Введи нове ім’я персонажа."
                    ),
                }

            except Exception as error:
                last_error = error
                try:
                    conn.rollback()
                except Exception:
                    pass
                locked = isinstance(error, sqlite3.OperationalError) and "locked" in str(error).lower()
                if locked and attempt < 3:
                    time.sleep(0.35 * attempt)
                    continue
                return {
                    "success": False,
                    "stage": stage,
                    "attempt": attempt,
                    "message": f"❌ DEV reset error at {stage}: {error}",
                }

    return {
        "success": False,
        "message": f"❌ DEV reset error: {last_error}",
    }

def generate_dynamic_equipment_stats(slot_key, item_level, rarity, weapon_hands=1, item_profile=None):
    stats = {
        "bonus_str": 0,
        "bonus_dex": 0,
        "bonus_int": 0,
        "bonus_wis": 0,
        "bonus_sta": 0,
        "pdef": 0,
        "mdef": 0
    }

    # ==============================
    # MAIN HAND
    # ==============================

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        profile_key = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key, item_profile)
        profile = MAIN_HAND_PROFILES.get(profile_key, MAIN_HAND_PROFILES["sword_1h"])

        main_stat = profile["main_stats"][0]
        base_multiplier = 1.00

        if profile["hands"] == 2:
            base_multiplier = 1.20

        value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, base_multiplier)
        add_stat_value(stats, main_stat, value)

        extra_pool = profile["extra_stats"]

    # ==============================
    # OFF HAND
    # ==============================

    elif slot_key == "off_hand":
        profile_key = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key, item_profile)
        profile = OFF_HAND_PROFILES.get(profile_key, OFF_HAND_PROFILES["shield"])

        if profile_key == "shield":
            stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.35)
            stats["bonus_sta"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.55)

        elif profile_key == "warrior_shield":
            # 60% of Knight shield PDEF: 1.35 * 0.60 = 0.81.
            stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.81)
            stats["bonus_str"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.65)
            stats["bonus_sta"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.35)

        elif profile_key == "talisman":
            stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.35)
            stats["bonus_wis"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.65)

        elif profile_key == "dagger":
            stats["bonus_dex"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.95)
            stats["bonus_str"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.35)

        extra_pool = profile["extra_stats"]

    # ==============================
    # ARMOR SLOTS
    # ==============================

    elif slot_key == "helmet":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.80)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.40)

        bonus = random.choice(["sta", "wis", "dex"])
        value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.25)
        add_stat_value(stats, bonus, value)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["sta"])

    elif slot_key == "shoulders":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.00)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.25)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["sta"])

    elif slot_key == "chest":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.60)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.35)
        stats["bonus_sta"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.55)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["sta"])

    elif slot_key == "gloves":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.55)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.20)
        stats["bonus_dex"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.60)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["dex"])

    elif slot_key == "legs":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.20)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.30)
        stats["bonus_sta"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.45)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["sta"])

    elif slot_key == "boots":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.45)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.20)
        stats["bonus_dex"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.80)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["dex"])

    # ==============================
    # JEWELRY
    # ==============================

    elif slot_key == "necklace":
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.30)
        stats["bonus_wis"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.80)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["wis", "int"])

    elif slot_key == "ring":
        stat_choice = random.choice(["str", "dex", "int", "wis", "sta"])
        value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.90)
        add_stat_value(stats, stat_choice, value)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["str", "dex", "int", "wis", "sta"])

    else:
        extra_pool = ["str", "dex", "int", "wis", "sta"]

    # ==============================
    # EXTRA BONUSES BY RARITY
    # ==============================

    if rarity in ["uncommon", "rare", "epic"]:
        bonus_count = 1
        min_bonus = 2

        if rarity == "rare":
            bonus_count = 2
            min_bonus = 3

        if rarity == "epic":
            bonus_count = 3
            min_bonus = 4

        for _ in range(bonus_count):
            bonus_type = random.choice(extra_pool)

            bonus_value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.30)
            bonus_value = max(min_bonus, bonus_value)

            add_stat_value(stats, bonus_type, bonus_value)

    return stats

def apply_armor_type_primary_stat_profile_to_stats(stats, armor_type):
    """
    Перерозподіляє основні характеристики броні залежно від armor_type.

    cloth   -> INT / WIS / STA
    leather -> DEX / STR / STA
    chain   -> STR / STA / рідко DEX
    plate   -> STA / STR
    """

    armor_type = normalize_equipment_restriction_value(armor_type)

    if not armor_type:
        return stats

    profile = ARMOR_PRIMARY_STAT_PROFILES.get(armor_type)

    if not profile:
        return stats

    existing_budget = get_existing_primary_stat_budget(stats)

    if existing_budget <= 0:
        return stats

    clear_primary_stat_bonuses(stats)

    main_multiplier = float(profile.get("main_multiplier", 1.0))
    secondary_multiplier = float(profile.get("secondary_multiplier", 0.5))

    primary_value = int(round(existing_budget * main_multiplier))
    secondary_value = int(round(existing_budget * secondary_multiplier))

    primary_value = max(1, primary_value)

    if existing_budget >= 2:
        secondary_value = max(1, secondary_value)
    else:
        secondary_value = 0

    primary_stat = pick_weighted_stat(
        profile.get("primary_weights", []),
        exclude_stat=None
    )

    secondary_stat = None

    if secondary_value > 0:
        secondary_stat = pick_weighted_stat(
            profile.get("secondary_weights", []),
            exclude_stat=primary_stat
        )

    add_primary_stat_to_stats(
        stats=stats,
        stat_key=primary_stat,
        value=primary_value
    )

    if secondary_stat:
        add_primary_stat_to_stats(
            stats=stats,
            stat_key=secondary_stat,
            value=secondary_value
        )

    return stats

def apply_armor_type_defense_profile_to_stats(stats, armor_type):
    """
    Центральна функція профілю броні.

    Робить 2 речі:
    1. Перерозподіляє PDEF/MDEF залежно від armor_type.
    2. Перерозподіляє основні характеристики залежно від armor_type.
    """

    armor_type = normalize_equipment_restriction_value(armor_type)

    if not armor_type:
        return stats

    # ==============================
    # 1. PDEF / MDEF redistribution
    # ==============================

    defense_profile = ARMOR_DEFENSE_DISTRIBUTION_PROFILES.get(armor_type)

    if defense_profile:
        base_pdef = int(stats.get("pdef", 0) or 0)
        base_mdef = int(stats.get("mdef", 0) or 0)
        base_total = base_pdef + base_mdef

        if base_total > 0:
            total_multiplier = float(defense_profile.get("total_multiplier", 1.0))
            pdef_share = float(defense_profile.get("pdef_share", 0.5))
            mdef_share = float(defense_profile.get("mdef_share", 0.5))

            total_defense = int(round(base_total * total_multiplier))

            if total_defense < 2:
                total_defense = 2

            new_pdef = int(round(total_defense * pdef_share))
            new_mdef = int(round(total_defense * mdef_share))

            new_pdef = max(1, new_pdef)
            new_mdef = max(1, new_mdef)

            # Гарантія: тканина завжди має MDEF > PDEF.
            if armor_type == "cloth" and new_mdef <= new_pdef:
                total = max(2, new_pdef + new_mdef)
                new_mdef = max(1, int(round(total * 0.70)))
                new_pdef = max(1, total - new_mdef)

                if new_mdef <= new_pdef:
                    new_mdef = new_pdef + 1

            # Гарантія: лати завжди мають PDEF > MDEF.
            if armor_type == "plate" and new_pdef <= new_mdef:
                total = max(2, new_pdef + new_mdef)
                new_pdef = max(1, int(round(total * 0.88)))
                new_mdef = max(1, total - new_pdef)

                if new_pdef <= new_mdef:
                    new_pdef = new_mdef + 1

            stats["pdef"] = new_pdef
            stats["mdef"] = new_mdef

    # ==============================
    # 2. Primary stats redistribution
    # ==============================

    stats = apply_armor_type_primary_stat_profile_to_stats(
        stats=stats,
        armor_type=armor_type
    )

    return stats

def create_dev_armor_item_for_test(user_id, armor_type, slot_key="chest", item_level=None, rarity="common"):
    """
    DEV-функція.
    Створює броню конкретного armor_type незалежно від класу.

    Приклад:
    create_dev_armor_item_for_test(user_id, "plate", "chest", 5, "rare")
    """

    init_dynamic_equipment_system()
    init_weapon_damage_system()
    init_class_equipment_restrictions_system()

    armor_type = normalize_equipment_restriction_value(armor_type)
    rarity = normalize_dev_rarity(rarity)

    if armor_type not in ["cloth", "leather", "chain", "plate"]:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                "❌ Невідомий тип броні.\n\n"
                "Доступно:\n"
                "cloth, leather, chain, plate"
            )
        }

    if slot_key not in ARMOR_SLOTS:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                "❌ Невідомий слот броні.\n\n"
                "Доступно:\n"
                "helmet, shoulders, chest, gloves, legs, boots"
            )
        }

    if item_level is None:
        item_level = get_player_level(user_id)

    try:
        item_level = int(item_level)
    except Exception:
        item_level = get_player_level(user_id)

    item_level = max(1, item_level)

    capacity = get_bag_capacity(user_id)
    used_slots = get_inventory_used_slots(user_id)

    if used_slots >= capacity:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "🎒 Сумка переповнена. Предмет не створено."
        }

    item_profile = ""
    weapon_hands = 1
    weapon_attack_type = ""

    base_name = get_dynamic_armor_name(slot_key, rarity)
    armor_label = get_armor_type_label(armor_type)
    name = f"{base_name} [{armor_label}] {item_level} рівня"

    stats = generate_dynamic_equipment_stats(
        slot_key=slot_key,
        item_level=item_level,
        rarity=rarity,
        weapon_hands=weapon_hands,
        item_profile=item_profile
    )

    stats = apply_armor_type_defense_profile_to_stats(
        stats=stats,
        armor_type=armor_type
    )

    sell_price = get_dynamic_sell_price(item_level, rarity)

    item_id = allocate_generated_item_id(conn)
    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO items (
        id,
        name,
        type,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        max_stack,
        sell_price,
        bonus_str,
        bonus_dex,
        bonus_int,
        bonus_wis,
        bonus_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        item_level,
        is_generated,
        item_subtype,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type,
        armor_type
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        item_id,
        name,
        slot_key,
        rarity,
        "equipment",
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        1,
        sell_price,
        stats["bonus_str"],
        stats["bonus_dex"],
        stats["bonus_int"],
        stats["bonus_wis"],
        stats["bonus_sta"],
        stats["pdef"],
        stats["mdef"],
        item_level,
        1,
        item_profile,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        weapon_attack_type,
        armor_type
    ))


    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO inventory (
        user_id,
        item_id,
        quantity,
        durability
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        user_id,
        item_id,
        1,
        100
    ))

    inventory_id = cursor.lastrowid

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": (
            f"✅ DEV: броню створено.\n\n"
            f"📦 {name}\n"
            f"🎯 Слот: {EQUIPMENT_SLOTS.get(slot_key, slot_key)}\n"
            f"🧵 Тип броні: {get_armor_type_label(armor_type)}\n"
            f"🏷 Рівень: {item_level}\n"
            f"⭐ Рідкість: {rarity}\n"
            f"🆔 inventory_id: {inventory_id}"
        ),
        "item_id": item_id,
        "inventory_id": inventory_id,
        "armor_type": armor_type,
        "slot_key": slot_key
    }

def create_dev_weapon_item_for_test(user_id, item_profile, item_level=None, rarity="common"):
    """
    DEV-функція.
    Створює зброю або off-hand конкретного item_subtype незалежно від класу.

    Приклади:
    create_dev_weapon_item_for_test(user_id, "dagger_1h", 5, "rare")
    create_dev_weapon_item_for_test(user_id, "shield", 5, "common")
    """

    init_dynamic_equipment_system()
    init_weapon_damage_system()
    init_class_equipment_restrictions_system()

    item_profile = normalize_equipment_restriction_value(item_profile)
    rarity = normalize_dev_rarity(rarity)

    if item_profile in MAIN_HAND_PROFILES:
        slot_key = "main_hand"
        profile = MAIN_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]
        weapon_hands = profile["hands"]
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]
        type_ = "weapon"

    elif item_profile in OFF_HAND_PROFILES:
        slot_key = "off_hand"
        profile = OFF_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]
        weapon_hands = 1
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]
        type_ = "offhand"

    else:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                "❌ Невідомий тип зброї / off-hand.\n\n"
                "Main hand:\n"
                "sword_1h, dagger_1h, wand_1h, sword_2h, staff_2h, bow_2h, crossbow_2h\n\n"
                "Off hand:\n"
                "shield, talisman, dagger"
            )
        }

    if item_level is None:
        item_level = get_player_level(user_id)

    try:
        item_level = int(item_level)
    except Exception:
        item_level = get_player_level(user_id)

    item_level = max(1, item_level)

    capacity = get_bag_capacity(user_id)
    used_slots = get_inventory_used_slots(user_id)

    if used_slots >= capacity:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "🎒 Сумка переповнена. Предмет не створено."
        }

    name = get_dynamic_weapon_name(
        slot_key=slot_key,
        rarity=rarity,
        weapon_hands=weapon_hands,
        item_profile=item_profile
    )

    name = f"{name} {item_level} рівня"

    stats = generate_dynamic_equipment_stats(
        slot_key=slot_key,
        item_level=item_level,
        rarity=rarity,
        weapon_hands=weapon_hands,
        item_profile=item_profile
    )

    sell_price = get_dynamic_sell_price(item_level, rarity)

    weapon_min_damage = 0
    weapon_max_damage = 0
    weapon_min_magic_damage = 0
    weapon_max_magic_damage = 0

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        min_dmg, max_dmg = calculate_weapon_damage_by_values(
            item_level=item_level,
            rarity=rarity,
            weapon_hands=weapon_hands
        )

        if weapon_attack_type == "magical":
            weapon_min_magic_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_magic_damage = max_dmg
        else:
            weapon_min_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_damage = max_dmg

    item_id = allocate_generated_item_id(conn)
    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO items (
        id,
        name,
        type,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        max_stack,
        sell_price,
        bonus_str,
        bonus_dex,
        bonus_int,
        bonus_wis,
        bonus_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        item_level,
        is_generated,
        item_subtype,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type,
        armor_type
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        item_id,
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        "equipment",
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        1,
        sell_price,
        stats["bonus_str"],
        stats["bonus_dex"],
        stats["bonus_int"],
        stats["bonus_wis"],
        stats["bonus_sta"],
        stats["pdef"],
        stats["mdef"],
        item_level,
        1,
        item_profile,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type,
        ""
    ))


    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO inventory (
        user_id,
        item_id,
        quantity,
        durability
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        user_id,
        item_id,
        1,
        100
    ))

    inventory_id = cursor.lastrowid

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": (
            f"✅ DEV: зброю / off-hand створено.\n\n"
            f"📦 {name}\n"
            f"🎯 Слот: {EQUIPMENT_SLOTS.get(slot_key, slot_key)}\n"
            f"⚔️ Тип предмета: {get_item_subtype_label(item_profile)}\n"
            f"🏷 Рівень: {item_level}\n"
            f"⭐ Рідкість: {rarity}\n"
            f"🆔 inventory_id: {inventory_id}"
        ),
        "item_id": item_id,
        "inventory_id": inventory_id,
        "item_subtype": item_profile,
        "slot_key": slot_key
    }

def get_all_equipped_slots(user_id):
    """
    Повертає словник {slot_key: inventory_id} для всіх слотів екіпірування.
    """
    from .connection import cursor, SLOT_ORDER
    
    ensure_equipment_slots(user_id)

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT slot_key, inventory_id
    FROM equipment_slots
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    result = {}

    for slot_key, inventory_id in rows:
        result[slot_key] = inventory_id

    for slot_key in SLOT_ORDER:
        result.setdefault(slot_key, None)

    return result

def get_inventory_entry(user_id_or_inventory_id, inventory_id=None):
    """Return inventory entry with both historical call signatures.

    Supported:
    - get_inventory_entry(inventory_id)
    - get_inventory_entry(user_id, inventory_id)
    """
    if inventory_id is None:
        return _equipment_system().get_inventory_entry(user_id_or_inventory_id)

    user_id = int(user_id_or_inventory_id)
    inventory_id = int(inventory_id)
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT inv.id, inv.item_id, it.name, it.type, it.category, "
        "COALESCE(inv.quantity, 1), COALESCE(inv.refine_level, 0) "
        "FROM inventory inv JOIN items it ON it.id=inv.item_id "
        "WHERE inv.user_id=? AND inv.id=?",
        (user_id, inventory_id),
    ).fetchone()
    if not row:
        return None

    values = list(row)
    values[2] = format_refined_item_name(values[2], values[-1])
    values.pop()
    return tuple(values)

def generate_dynamic_equipment_stats(slot_key, item_level, rarity, weapon_hands=1, item_profile=None):
    stats = {
        "bonus_str": 0,
        "bonus_dex": 0,
        "bonus_int": 0,
        "bonus_wis": 0,
        "bonus_sta": 0,
        "pdef": 0,
        "mdef": 0
    }

    # ==============================
    # MAIN HAND
    # ==============================

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        profile_key = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key, item_profile)
        profile = MAIN_HAND_PROFILES.get(profile_key, MAIN_HAND_PROFILES["sword_1h"])

        main_stat = profile["main_stats"][0]
        base_multiplier = 1.00

        if profile["hands"] == 2:
            base_multiplier = 1.20

        value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, base_multiplier)
        add_stat_value(stats, main_stat, value)

        extra_pool = profile["extra_stats"]

    # ==============================
    # OFF HAND
    # ==============================

    elif slot_key == "off_hand":
        profile_key = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key, item_profile)
        profile = OFF_HAND_PROFILES.get(profile_key, OFF_HAND_PROFILES["shield"])

        if profile_key == "shield":
            stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.35)
            stats["bonus_sta"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.55)

        elif profile_key == "warrior_shield":
            # 60% of Knight shield PDEF: 1.35 * 0.60 = 0.81.
            stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.81)
            stats["bonus_str"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.65)
            stats["bonus_sta"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.35)

        elif profile_key == "talisman":
            stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.35)
            stats["bonus_wis"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.65)

        elif profile_key == "dagger":
            stats["bonus_dex"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.95)
            stats["bonus_str"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.35)

        extra_pool = profile["extra_stats"]

    # ==============================
    # ARMOR SLOTS
    # ==============================

    elif slot_key == "helmet":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.80)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.40)

        bonus = random.choice(["sta", "wis", "dex"])
        value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.25)
        add_stat_value(stats, bonus, value)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["sta"])

    elif slot_key == "shoulders":
        # Shoulders use the same primary-stat pipeline as the other armor slots.
        # Source-specific shop/loot resolvers redistribute this raw budget later.
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.00)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.25)
        stats["bonus_sta"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.40)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["sta", "str"])

    elif slot_key == "chest":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.60)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.35)
        stats["bonus_sta"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.55)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["sta"])

    elif slot_key == "gloves":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.55)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.20)
        stats["bonus_dex"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.60)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["dex"])

    elif slot_key == "legs":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.20)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.30)
        stats["bonus_sta"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.45)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["sta"])

    elif slot_key == "boots":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.45)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.20)
        stats["bonus_dex"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.80)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["dex"])

    # ==============================
    # JEWELRY
    # ==============================

    elif slot_key == "necklace":
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.30)
        stats["bonus_wis"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.80)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["wis", "int"])

    elif slot_key == "ring":
        stat_choice = random.choice(["str", "dex", "int", "wis", "sta"])
        value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.90)
        add_stat_value(stats, stat_choice, value)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["str", "dex", "int", "wis", "sta"])

    else:
        extra_pool = ["str", "dex", "int", "wis", "sta"]

    # ==============================
    # EXTRA BONUSES BY RARITY
    # ==============================

    if rarity in ["uncommon", "rare", "epic"]:
        bonus_count = 1
        min_bonus = 2

        if rarity == "rare":
            bonus_count = 2
            min_bonus = 3

        if rarity == "epic":
            bonus_count = 3
            min_bonus = 4

        for _ in range(bonus_count):
            bonus_type = random.choice(extra_pool)

            bonus_value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.30)
            bonus_value = max(min_bonus, bonus_value)

            add_stat_value(stats, bonus_type, bonus_value)

    return stats

def create_generated_equipment_item_for_slot(user_id, item_level, rarity, slot_key, item_profile=None):
    init_dynamic_equipment_system()
    init_weapon_damage_system()

    if slot_key not in SLOT_ORDER:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Невідомий слот спорядження."
        }

    item_level = int(item_level)
    item_level = max(1, item_level)

    if rarity not in ["common", "uncommon", "rare", "epic"]:
        rarity = "common"

    capacity = get_bag_capacity(user_id)
    used_slots = get_inventory_used_slots(user_id)

    if used_slots >= capacity:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "lost": 1,
            "message": "🎒 Сумка переповнена. Предмет не куплено."
        }

    item_profile = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key, item_profile)

    weapon_hands = 1
    weapon_attack_type = ""
    # Stage 20.6.5b: forced-slot generation must always provide an explicit
    # armor identity. Non-armor slots intentionally keep an empty armor type.
    armor_type = (
        get_allowed_armor_type_for_class(get_character_class(user_id))
        if is_armor_slot(slot_key)
        else ""
    )

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        profile = MAIN_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]
        weapon_hands = profile["hands"]
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]
        name = get_dynamic_weapon_name(slot_key, rarity, weapon_hands, item_profile)
        type_ = "weapon"

    elif slot_key == "off_hand":
        profile = OFF_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]
        weapon_hands = 1
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]
        name = get_dynamic_weapon_name(slot_key, rarity, weapon_hands, item_profile)
        type_ = "offhand"

    else:
        item_profile = ""
        weapon_hands = 1
        name = get_dynamic_armor_name(slot_key, rarity)
        type_ = slot_key

    name = f"{name} {item_level} рівня"

    stats = generate_dynamic_equipment_stats(
        slot_key=slot_key,
        item_level=item_level,
        rarity=rarity,
        weapon_hands=weapon_hands,
        item_profile=item_profile
    )

    # Stage 20.6.5: primary stats follow item identity, never recipient class.
    stats = redistribute_identity_primary_stats(
        stats,
        slot_key,
        item_subtype=item_profile,
        armor_type=armor_type,
        chooser=_class_aware_weighted_choice,
    )

    sell_price = get_dynamic_sell_price(item_level, rarity)

    weapon_min_damage = 0
    weapon_max_damage = 0
    weapon_min_magic_damage = 0
    weapon_max_magic_damage = 0

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        min_dmg, max_dmg = calculate_weapon_damage_by_values(
            item_level=item_level,
            rarity=rarity,
            weapon_hands=weapon_hands
        )

        if weapon_attack_type == "magical":
            weapon_min_magic_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_magic_damage = max_dmg
        else:
            weapon_min_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_damage = max_dmg

    item_id = allocate_generated_item_id(conn)
    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO items (
        id,
        name,
        type,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        max_stack,
        sell_price,
        bonus_str,
        bonus_dex,
        bonus_int,
        bonus_wis,
        bonus_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        item_level,
        is_generated,
        item_subtype,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        item_id,
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        "equipment",
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        1,
        sell_price,
        stats["bonus_str"],
        stats["bonus_dex"],
        stats["bonus_int"],
        stats["bonus_wis"],
        stats["bonus_sta"],
        stats["pdef"],
        stats["mdef"],
        item_level,
        1,
        item_profile,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type
    ))


    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO inventory (
        user_id,
        item_id,
        quantity,
        durability
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        user_id,
        item_id,
        1,
        100
    ))

    inventory_id = cursor.lastrowid

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "name": name,
        "item_id": item_id,
        "inventory_id": inventory_id,
        "slot_key": slot_key,
        "item_level": item_level
    }

def apply_armor_type_primary_stat_profile_to_stats(stats, armor_type):
    """
    Перерозподіляє основні характеристики броні залежно від armor_type.

    cloth   -> INT / WIS / STA
    leather -> DEX / STR / STA
    chain   -> STR / STA / рідко DEX
    plate   -> STA / STR
    """

    armor_type = normalize_equipment_restriction_value(armor_type)

    if not armor_type:
        return stats

    profile = ARMOR_PRIMARY_STAT_PROFILES.get(armor_type)

    if not profile:
        return stats

    existing_budget = get_existing_primary_stat_budget(stats)

    if existing_budget <= 0:
        return stats

    clear_primary_stat_bonuses(stats)

    main_multiplier = float(profile.get("main_multiplier", 1.0))
    secondary_multiplier = float(profile.get("secondary_multiplier", 0.5))

    primary_value = int(round(existing_budget * main_multiplier))
    secondary_value = int(round(existing_budget * secondary_multiplier))

    primary_value = max(1, primary_value)

    if existing_budget >= 2:
        secondary_value = max(1, secondary_value)
    else:
        secondary_value = 0

    primary_stat = pick_weighted_stat(
        profile.get("primary_weights", []),
        exclude_stat=None
    )

    secondary_stat = None

    if secondary_value > 0:
        secondary_stat = pick_weighted_stat(
            profile.get("secondary_weights", []),
            exclude_stat=primary_stat
        )

    add_primary_stat_to_stats(
        stats=stats,
        stat_key=primary_stat,
        value=primary_value
    )

    if secondary_stat:
        add_primary_stat_to_stats(
            stats=stats,
            stat_key=secondary_stat,
            value=secondary_value
        )

    return stats

def apply_armor_type_defense_profile_to_stats(stats, armor_type):
    """
    Центральна функція профілю броні.

    Робить 2 речі:
    1. Перерозподіляє PDEF/MDEF залежно від armor_type.
    2. Перерозподіляє основні характеристики залежно від armor_type.
    """

    armor_type = normalize_equipment_restriction_value(armor_type)

    if not armor_type:
        return stats

    # ==============================
    # 1. PDEF / MDEF redistribution
    # ==============================

    defense_profile = ARMOR_DEFENSE_DISTRIBUTION_PROFILES.get(armor_type)

    if defense_profile:
        base_pdef = int(stats.get("pdef", 0) or 0)
        base_mdef = int(stats.get("mdef", 0) or 0)
        base_total = base_pdef + base_mdef

        if base_total > 0:
            total_multiplier = float(defense_profile.get("total_multiplier", 1.0))
            pdef_share = float(defense_profile.get("pdef_share", 0.5))
            mdef_share = float(defense_profile.get("mdef_share", 0.5))

            total_defense = int(round(base_total * total_multiplier))

            if total_defense < 2:
                total_defense = 2

            new_pdef = int(round(total_defense * pdef_share))
            new_mdef = int(round(total_defense * mdef_share))

            new_pdef = max(1, new_pdef)
            new_mdef = max(1, new_mdef)

            # Гарантія: тканина завжди має MDEF > PDEF.
            if armor_type == "cloth" and new_mdef <= new_pdef:
                total = max(2, new_pdef + new_mdef)
                new_mdef = max(1, int(round(total * 0.70)))
                new_pdef = max(1, total - new_mdef)

                if new_mdef <= new_pdef:
                    new_mdef = new_pdef + 1

            # Гарантія: лати завжди мають PDEF > MDEF.
            if armor_type == "plate" and new_pdef <= new_mdef:
                total = max(2, new_pdef + new_mdef)
                new_pdef = max(1, int(round(total * 0.88)))
                new_mdef = max(1, total - new_pdef)

                if new_pdef <= new_mdef:
                    new_pdef = new_mdef + 1

            stats["pdef"] = new_pdef
            stats["mdef"] = new_mdef

    # ==============================
    # 2. Primary stats redistribution
    # ==============================

    stats = apply_armor_type_primary_stat_profile_to_stats(
        stats=stats,
        armor_type=armor_type
    )

    return stats

def create_generated_equipment_item(
    user_id,
    item_level,
    rarity,
    class_aware_chance=0.0
):
    """
    Динамічний дроп екіпірування з мобів.

    class_aware_chance:
    - 0.0 = повністю випадковий предмет;
    - 0.5 = 50% шанс предмета під клас;
    - 0.7 = 70% шанс предмета під клас.

    Для class-aware предмета:
    - броня отримує armor_type класу;
    - зброя отримує item_subtype, дозволений класу;
    - off-hand отримує item_subtype, дозволений класу.

    Для random предмета:
    - броня отримує випадковий armor_type;
    - зброя/off-hand отримує випадковий item_subtype.
    """

    init_dynamic_equipment_system()
    init_weapon_damage_system()
    init_class_equipment_restrictions_system()

    item_level = int(item_level)
    item_level = max(1, item_level)

    if rarity not in ["common", "uncommon", "rare", "epic"]:
        rarity = "common"

    capacity = get_bag_capacity(user_id)
    used_slots = get_inventory_used_slots(user_id)

    if used_slots >= capacity:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "lost": 1,
            "message": "🎒 Сумка переповнена. Екіпірування не влізло."
        }

    try:
        class_aware_chance = float(class_aware_chance or 0.0)
    except Exception:
        class_aware_chance = 0.0

    class_aware_chance = max(0.0, min(1.0, class_aware_chance))

    is_class_aware = random.random() <= class_aware_chance

    if is_class_aware:
        choice = get_random_class_aware_equipment_choice(user_id)
    else:
        choice = get_random_unrestricted_equipment_choice()

    slot_key = choice["slot_key"]
    item_profile = choice.get("item_profile", "")
    armor_type = choice.get("armor_type", "")

    weapon_hands = 1
    weapon_attack_type = ""

    # ==============================
    # MAIN HAND
    # ==============================

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        if item_profile not in MAIN_HAND_PROFILES:
            item_profile = get_random_main_hand_profile()

        profile = MAIN_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]

        weapon_hands = profile["hands"]
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]

        name = get_dynamic_weapon_name(
            slot_key=slot_key,
            rarity=rarity,
            weapon_hands=weapon_hands,
            item_profile=item_profile
        )

        type_ = "weapon"

    # ==============================
    # OFF HAND
    # ==============================

    elif slot_key == "off_hand":
        if item_profile not in OFF_HAND_PROFILES:
            item_profile = get_random_off_hand_profile()

        profile = OFF_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]

        weapon_hands = 1
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]

        name = get_dynamic_weapon_name(
            slot_key=slot_key,
            rarity=rarity,
            weapon_hands=weapon_hands,
            item_profile=item_profile
        )

        type_ = "offhand"

    # ==============================
    # ARMOR / ACCESSORIES
    # ==============================

    else:
        item_profile = ""
        weapon_hands = 1

        if is_armor_slot(slot_key):
            if not armor_type:
                armor_type = get_random_loot_armor_type()
        else:
            armor_type = ""

        name = get_dynamic_armor_name(slot_key, rarity)
        type_ = slot_key

    rarity_name = DYNAMIC_RARITY_NAMES.get(rarity, "Звичайний")
    name = f"{name} {item_level} рівня"

    stats = generate_dynamic_equipment_stats(
        slot_key=slot_key,
        item_level=item_level,
        rarity=rarity,
        weapon_hands=weapon_hands,
        item_profile=item_profile
    )

    if is_armor_slot(slot_key):
        stats = apply_armor_type_defense_profile_to_stats(
            stats=stats,
            armor_type=armor_type
        )

    # Stage 20.6.5: class-aware chance controls identity suitability only.
    # Stats always follow the selected subtype/armor type/universal jewelry pool.
    stats = redistribute_identity_primary_stats(
        stats,
        slot_key,
        item_subtype=item_profile,
        armor_type=armor_type,
        chooser=_class_aware_weighted_choice,
    )

    sell_price = get_dynamic_sell_price(item_level, rarity)

    weapon_min_damage = 0
    weapon_max_damage = 0
    weapon_min_magic_damage = 0
    weapon_max_magic_damage = 0

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        min_dmg, max_dmg = calculate_weapon_damage_by_values(
            item_level=item_level,
            rarity=rarity,
            weapon_hands=weapon_hands
        )

        if weapon_attack_type == "magical":
            weapon_min_magic_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_magic_damage = max_dmg
        else:
            weapon_min_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_damage = max_dmg

    item_id = allocate_generated_item_id(conn)
    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO items (
        id,
        name,
        type,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        max_stack,
        sell_price,
        bonus_str,
        bonus_dex,
        bonus_int,
        bonus_wis,
        bonus_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        item_level,
        is_generated,
        item_subtype,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type,
        armor_type
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        item_id,
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        "equipment",
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        1,
        sell_price,
        stats["bonus_str"],
        stats["bonus_dex"],
        stats["bonus_int"],
        stats["bonus_wis"],
        stats["bonus_sta"],
        stats["pdef"],
        stats["mdef"],
        item_level,
        1,
        item_profile,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type,
        armor_type
    ))


    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO inventory (
        user_id,
        item_id,
        quantity,
        durability
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        user_id,
        item_id,
        1,
        100
    ))

    inventory_id = cursor.lastrowid

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "lost": 0,
        "name": name,
        "rarity": rarity,
        "rarity_name": rarity_name,
        "slot_key": slot_key,
        "item_id": item_id,
        "inventory_id": inventory_id,
        "armor_type": armor_type,
        "item_subtype": item_profile,
        "class_aware": is_class_aware,
        "message": f"{name}"
    }

def get_all_equipped_slots(user_id):

    ensure_equipment_slots(user_id)



    cursor.execute("""

    SELECT slot_key, inventory_id

    FROM equipment_slots

    WHERE user_id=?

def run_db_startup_maintenance():
    """
    Run idempotent database maintenance explicitly during application startup.
    """
    from data.balance import REFINE_MATERIAL_MAX_STACK
    
    result = {
        "success": False,
        "refine_material_stack_sizes": None,
        "contract_target_kills": None,
    }

    # Refine material stack sizes fix
    try:
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE items
        SET max_stack=?
        WHERE id IN (401, 402)
        """, (REFINE_MATERIAL_MAX_STACK,))
        conn.commit()
        result["refine_material_stack_sizes"] = True
    except Exception:
        result["refine_material_stack_sizes"] = False

    # Contract target kills migration
    try:
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE user_active_contracts
        SET target_kills=5
        WHERE target_kills > 5
        """)

        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE user_active_contracts
        SET completed=1,
            current_kills=5
        WHERE target_kills=5
          AND current_kills >= 5
          AND reward_claimed=0
        """)

        conn.commit()
        result["contract_target_kills"] = True
    except Exception:
        result["contract_target_kills"] = False

    result["success"] = True
    return result

def get_player_attack_profile(user_id):
    character_class = get_character_class(user_id)
    """Return weapon profile with stat attack from canonical production APIs."""
    from .equipment import get_equipped_slot, get_weapon_damage_by_inventory_id

    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)
    if not stats:
        return {
            "weapon_subtype": "",
            "attack_type": resolve_basic_attack_type(character_class),
            "stat_attack": 0,
            "weapon_min_damage": 0,
            "weapon_max_damage": 0,
            "display_attack": 0,
            "weapon_text": "Без зброї",
        }

    physical_stat_attack = get_attack(user_id)
    magical_stat_attack = get_magic_attack(user_id)
    attack_type = resolve_basic_attack_type(character_class)
    stat_attack = magical_stat_attack if attack_type == "magical" else physical_stat_attack
    main_hand_id = get_equipped_slot(user_id, "main_hand")

    if not main_hand_id:
        return {
            "weapon_subtype": "",
            "attack_type": resolve_basic_attack_type(character_class),
            "stat_attack": stat_attack,
            "weapon_min_damage": 0,
            "weapon_max_damage": 0,
            "display_attack": stat_attack,
            "weapon_text": "Без зброї",
        }

    weapon_data = get_weapon_damage_by_inventory_id(main_hand_id)
    if not weapon_data.get("is_weapon"):
        return {
            "weapon_subtype": "",
            "attack_type": resolve_basic_attack_type(character_class),
            "stat_attack": stat_attack,
            "weapon_min_damage": 0,
            "weapon_max_damage": 0,
            "display_attack": stat_attack,
            "weapon_text": "Без зброї",
        }

    
    if attack_type == "magical":
        weapon_min = weapon_data["magic_min"]
        weapon_max = weapon_data["magic_max"]
    else:
        weapon_min = weapon_data["physical_min"]
        weapon_max = weapon_data["physical_max"]

    display_attack = stat_attack + weapon_max
    return {
        "weapon_subtype": str(weapon_data.get("item_subtype") or "").strip().lower(),
        "attack_type": attack_type,
        "stat_attack": stat_attack,
        "weapon_min_damage": weapon_min,
        "weapon_max_damage": weapon_max,
        "display_attack": display_attack,
        "weapon_text": weapon_data.get("text"),
    }

def get_refine_total_armor_hp_bonus_percent(user_id):
    """
    Повертає сумарний HP% бонус від заточеної броні.
    """
    from systems.refine_system import get_armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent
    from systems.equipment_system import get_all_equipped_items
    
    init_refine_system()
    
    armor_slots = {
        "helmet",
        "shoulders",
        "chest",
        "gloves",
        "legs",
        "boots",
    }
    
    equipped_items = get_all_equipped_items(user_id)
    total_bonus = 0.0
    
    for item in equipped_items:
        slot_key = item.get("slot_key")
        if slot_key not in armor_slots:
            continue
        
        inventory_id = item.get("inventory_id")
        if not inventory_id:
            continue
        
        cursor.execute("""
        SELECT
            inventory.refine_level,
            items.rarity
        FROM inventory
        JOIN items ON inventory.item_id = items.id
        WHERE inventory.id=? AND inventory.user_id=?
        """, (inventory_id, user_id))
        
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        if not row:
            continue
        
        refine_level, rarity = row
        
        try:
            refine_level = int(refine_level or 0)
        except Exception:
            refine_level = 0
        
        if refine_level <= 0:
            continue
        
        total_bonus += float(
            get_armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent(
                refine_level=refine_level,
                rarity=rarity
            )
        )
    
    return round(total_bonus, 2)

    if slot_key == "off_hand":

        return [

                "name": OFF_HAND_PROFILES[profile_key]["name"],

                "attack_type": OFF_HAND_PROFILES[profile_key]["attack_type"],

            }
            for profile_key in allowed_profiles
        ]

    return []

def create_common_equipment_shop_preview(user_id, slot_key, item_profile=None):
    """
    Створює preview-предмет у таблиці items для попереднього перегляду покупки.
    """
    from systems import dynamic_equipment_system
    from systems.equipment_system import is_armor_slot
    from .equipment import init_weapon_damage_system, calculate_weapon_damage_by_values
    from .player import get_player_level
    from .inventory import get_bag_capacity, get_inventory_used_slots
    from .utils import format_gold
    from .character import get_character_class
    from data.equipment_stat_policy import redistribute_primary_stat_budget

    
    # Init systems
    try:
        dynamic_equipment_system.init_dynamic_equipment_system()
    except:
        pass
    
    init_weapon_damage_system()
    init_shop_preview_system()
    cleanup_shop_previews_for_user(user_id)

    if slot_key not in SLOT_ORDER:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Невідомий слот спорядження."
        }

    if slot_key == "main_hand" and item_profile not in MAIN_HAND_PROFILES:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Невідомий тип зброї."
        }

    if slot_key == "off_hand" and item_profile not in OFF_HAND_PROFILES:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Невідомий тип предмета для другої руки."
        }

    if slot_key in ["main_hand", "off_hand"]:
        if not is_shop_profile_allowed_for_user(user_id, slot_key, item_profile):
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": "❌ Цей предмет не підходить твоєму класу."
            }

    player_level = get_player_level(user_id)
    item_level = player_level
    rarity = "common"
    price = get_common_equipment_price_for_slot(item_level, slot_key)

    item_profile = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key, item_profile)

    weapon_hands = 1
    weapon_attack_type = ""
    armor_type = ""

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        profile = MAIN_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]
        weapon_hands = profile["hands"]
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]
        name = dynamic_equipment_system.get_dynamic_weapon_name(slot_key, rarity, weapon_hands, item_profile)
        type_ = "weapon"

    elif slot_key == "off_hand":
        profile = OFF_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]
        weapon_hands = 1
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]
        name = dynamic_equipment_system.get_dynamic_weapon_name(slot_key, rarity, weapon_hands, item_profile)
        type_ = "offhand"

    else:
        item_profile = ""
        weapon_hands = 1
        armor_type = get_shop_armor_type_for_user(user_id)
        name = dynamic_equipment_system.get_dynamic_armor_name(slot_key, rarity)
        type_ = slot_key

    name = f"{name} {item_level} рівня"

    stats = dynamic_equipment_system.generate_dynamic_equipment_stats(
        slot_key=slot_key,
        item_level=item_level,
        rarity=rarity,
        weapon_hands=weapon_hands,
        item_profile=item_profile
    )

    if is_armor_slot(slot_key):
        stats = dynamic_equipment_system.apply_armor_type_defense_profile_to_stats(
            stats=stats,
            armor_type=armor_type
        )

    # Stage 20.6.5b: the base shop is strict class-aware, including jewelry.
    # Mob loot remains identity-aware and keeps universal random jewelry stats.
    target_class = get_character_class(user_id)
    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        equipment_kind = "weapon"
    elif slot_key == "off_hand":
        equipment_kind = "off_hand"
    elif slot_key in ("necklace", "ring"):
        equipment_kind = "jewelry"
    else:
        equipment_kind = "armor"
    stats = redistribute_primary_stat_budget(
        stats,
        target_class,
        equipment_kind,
        item_subtype=item_profile,
        chooser=lambda profile: random.choices(
            [stat for stat, _weight in profile],
            weights=[weight for _stat, weight in profile],
            k=1,
        )[0],
    )

    sell_price = dynamic_equipment_system.get_dynamic_sell_price(item_level, rarity)

    weapon_min_damage = 0
    weapon_max_damage = 0
    weapon_min_magic_damage = 0
    weapon_max_magic_damage = 0

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        min_dmg, max_dmg = calculate_weapon_damage_by_values(
            item_level=item_level,
            rarity=rarity,
            weapon_hands=weapon_hands
        )

        if weapon_attack_type == "magical":
            weapon_min_magic_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_magic_damage = max_dmg
        else:
            weapon_min_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_damage = max_dmg

    item_id = allocate_shop_preview_item_id(conn)
    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO items (
        id,
        name,
        type,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        max_stack,
        sell_price,
        bonus_str,
        bonus_dex,
        bonus_int,
        bonus_wis,
        bonus_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        item_level,
        is_generated,
        item_subtype,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type,
        armor_type,
        shop_preview_owner,
        shop_preview_price
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        item_id,
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        "equipment",
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        1,
        sell_price,
        stats["bonus_str"],
        stats["bonus_dex"],
        stats["bonus_int"],
        stats["bonus_wis"],
        stats["bonus_sta"],
        stats["pdef"],
        stats["mdef"],
        item_level,
        1,
        item_profile,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type,
        armor_type,
        user_id,
        price
    ))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "item_id": item_id,
        "price": price,
        "name": name,
        "armor_type": armor_type,
        "item_subtype": item_profile
    }

def can_class_equip_item(character_class, item):
    """
    Перевіряє чи може клас екіпірувати предмет.
    item: dict з полями type, armor_type, weapon_attack_type
    """
    from systems.character_system import get_class_equipment_rules
    
    rules = get_class_equipment_rules(character_class)
    
    item_type = item.get("type", "")
    armor_type = item.get("armor_type", "")
    weapon_attack_type = item.get("weapon_attack_type", "")
    
    # Armor restrictions
    if item_type == "armor":
        allowed_armor = rules.get("allowed_armor_types", [])
        if armor_type and allowed_armor and armor_type not in allowed_armor:
            return False
    
    # Weapon restrictions
    if item_type == "weapon":
        allowed_weapons = rules.get("allowed_weapon_types", [])
        if weapon_attack_type and allowed_weapons and weapon_attack_type not in allowed_weapons:
            return False
    
    return True

def generate_class_shop_equipment(character_class, player_level):
    """Return canonical read-only class-shop offer descriptors.

    Compatibility API only. This function does not generate random stats, create
    item rows, or create shop previews. Actual preview creation remains owned by
    create_common_equipment_shop_preview(user_id, slot_key, item_profile).
    """
    from data.equipment_stat_policy import (
        CLASS_ARMOR_TYPES,
        CLASS_MAIN_HAND_SUBTYPES,
        CLASS_OFF_HAND_SUBTYPES,
        normalize_equipment_class,
    )

    class_key = normalize_equipment_class(character_class)
    try:
        item_level = max(1, int(player_level))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        item_level = 1

    offers = []
    armor_type = CLASS_ARMOR_TYPES[class_key]
    for slot_key in ("helmet", "shoulders", "chest", "gloves", "legs", "boots"):
        offers.append({
            "slot_key": slot_key,
            "item_profile": "",
            "armor_type": armor_type,
            "item_level": item_level,
            "rarity": "common",
            "target_class": class_key,
            "preview_api": "create_common_equipment_shop_preview",
        })

    for item_profile in CLASS_MAIN_HAND_SUBTYPES[class_key]:
        offers.append({
            "slot_key": "main_hand",
            "item_profile": item_profile,
            "armor_type": "",
            "item_level": item_level,
            "rarity": "common",
            "target_class": class_key,
            "preview_api": "create_common_equipment_shop_preview",
        })

    for item_profile in CLASS_OFF_HAND_SUBTYPES[class_key]:
        offers.append({
            "slot_key": "off_hand",
            "item_profile": item_profile,
            "armor_type": "",
            "item_level": item_level,
            "rarity": "common",
            "target_class": class_key,
            "preview_api": "create_common_equipment_shop_preview",
        })

    return offers

def skip_active_story_quest(
    connection,
    *,
    user_id: int,
    quest_id: str,
    timestamp: Optional[str] = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Mark one ACTIVE quest SKIPPED and remove only its isolated quest items.

    The caller owns commit or rollback, so status and item cleanup can remain in
    the same transaction as the future over-level lifecycle operation.
    """
    row = get_story_quest(connection, user_id, quest_id)
    if row is None or row["status"] != "ACTIVE":
        raise StoryQuestConflictError("quest is not ACTIVE")
    now = str(timestamp or utc_now_iso())
    updated = connection.execute(
        """UPDATE user_story_quests
        SET status='SKIPPED', skipped_at=?, updated_at=?
        WHERE user_id=? AND quest_id=? AND status='ACTIVE'""",
        (now, now, int(user_id), str(quest_id)),
    )
    if updated.rowcount != 1:
        raise StoryQuestConflictError("ACTIVE quest changed concurrently")
    connection.execute(
        "DELETE FROM user_story_quest_items WHERE user_id=? AND quest_id=?",
        (int(user_id), str(quest_id)),
    )
    return get_story_quest(connection, user_id, quest_id)
